name: asmsdk
description: AsmSdk (AsmFoundation.Sdk 0.3.0): x86-64 and ARM64 assembly for Windows, Linux and macOS as .asmproj projects built with dotnet build, shared as versioned NuGet packages and P/Invoked from .csproj projects. A skill with the complete SDK reference, the per-OS NASM rules and verified footguns, and scripts to scaffold for every RID, lint per OS and inspect ELF, PE and Mach-O outputs.
